punchline: The $700 billion request lost its first House vote 205 to 228.
thirty_sec: In September 2008 Paulson and Bernanke asked Congress for up to $700 billion. After a White House meeting broke up badly on 25 September, the House rejected the bill 205 to 228 on 29 September and the Dow fell 777.68 points. A revised bill with oversight bodies passed on 3 October.
question: Which checks on your biggest request could you offer before anyone asks?
key_contrast: A deal announced by leaders versus the votes of the members.
